precincts.name: Port Approach
precincts.role: Approach control and sensors for the port docks and the Hall of Arrivals
precincts.intro: 5,435 × 9,262 ft (1.66 × 2.82 km). Controllers who bring every ship into the port docks and the Hall of Arrivals.

buildings.name: Port Approach Control
buildings.notes: controllers for the port docks and the Hall of Arrivals
buildings.purpose: The approach control room for the port side. Controllers here guide every ship and shuttle coming in to the port docks and the Hall of Arrivals.

buildings.name: Port Sensor Hall
buildings.notes: radar and sensor arrays for the port approaches
buildings.purpose: The radar and sensor hall that tracks every craft approaching the port side of the ship.

buildings.name: Pilot Boat Station
buildings.notes: pilot craft that guide big ships in
buildings.purpose: The base for pilot boats, small craft that fly out to meet big ships and guide them safely into their berths.

buildings.name: Port Controllers' Lodge
buildings.notes: rest rooms for controllers on shift
buildings.purpose: Rest rooms for port approach controllers between shifts, so they stay close to the control room.

buildings.name: Port Approach Fire Station
buildings.purpose: The fire and rescue station covering the Port Approach precinct and its control rooms.

buildings.name: Port Antenna Plant

buildings.purpose: The plant that supplies power and cooling to the antennas on the hull above the port approaches.

precincts.name: Briefing Halls
precincts.role: Main briefing hall, flight plans, space weather, investigations
precincts.intro: 5,435 × 8,202 ft (1.66 × 2.50 km). Every flight on and off the ship is briefed and filed here.

buildings.name: Main Briefing Hall
buildings.notes: 1,500 seats · daily flight briefings for the whole deck
buildings.purpose: The deck's main briefing hall, where crews gather every day for the flight briefing that covers traffic, weather and orders for the whole deck.

buildings.name: Squadron Briefing Rooms
buildings.notes: forty rooms for crews and squadrons
buildings.purpose: Smaller briefing rooms where individual crews and squadrons are briefed before flights and debriefed after.

buildings.name: Flight Plans Office
buildings.notes: every flight on and off the ship is filed here
buildings.purpose: The office where every flight on and off the ship is filed and checked before it is cleared.

buildings.name: Space Weather Office
buildings.notes: storms, debris and solar wind forecasts
buildings.purpose: The forecasting office for space weather, warning pilots and controllers of storms, debris and solar wind.

buildings.name: Navigation Charts Library
buildings.purpose: The library of navigation charts for the Drift Network, used by pilots and planners to plot routes.

buildings.name: Accident Investigation Board
buildings.purpose: The board that investigates every flight incident and accident, finds the cause and recommends changes.

buildings.name: Flight Officers' Club
buildings.purpose: The flight officers' club, with dining and lounges for officers off duty.

buildings.name: Briefing Halls Canteen
buildings.purpose: The canteen serving meals to briefing staff and crews between briefings.

buildings.name: Briefing Halls Utility Plant
buildings.purpose: The utility plant for the Briefing Halls precinct, supplying power, air and water.

buildings.notes: access to the 60 m service layer
buildings.purpose: The Briefing Halls shaft down to the service layer, used for maintenance and deliveries.

buildings.purpose: An overflow building with more briefing rooms in the Briefing Halls, used when the main hall and squadron rooms are full.

precincts.name: Beacon
precincts.role: The Beacon tower (canon), master traffic control room, Keelway
precincts.intro: 5,435 × 4,921 ft (1.66 × 1.50 km). The Beacon (canon), the deck's control tower, stands at F57 beside the Keelway with the master traffic room next to it.
precincts.exclude_note: Atrium Plaza (canon) is not part of the precinct

buildings.name: The Beacon
buildings.notes: Canon landmark: the deck's control tower. Footprint and place proposed; height not designed yet
buildings.purpose: The Beacon, Aerion's flight control tower and the landmark of Flight Control, overlooking the flight deck.

buildings.name: Traffic Control Centre
buildings.notes: the deck's master traffic room: every craft from launch to landing
buildings.purpose: The deck's master traffic room. Controllers here follow every craft on Deck 5 from launch to landing.

buildings.name: Backup Control Room
buildings.notes: hardened standby for the Traffic Control Centre
buildings.purpose: A hardened standby control room that takes over traffic control if the main Traffic Control Centre fails.

buildings.name: Beacon Plaza
buildings.notes: square at the foot of the Beacon
buildings.purpose: The square at the foot of the Beacon, the open heart of Flight Control.

buildings.name: Controllers' Rest Hall
buildings.purpose: Quiet rooms where traffic controllers rest between shifts.

buildings.name: Beacon Pod Stop
buildings.purpose: The pod stop on the Keelway beside the Beacon, bringing controllers and visitors to Flight Control.

buildings.name: Beacon Utility Plant
buildings.purpose: The utility plant for the Beacon precinct, supplying power, air and water.

precincts.name: Dispatch
precincts.role: Dispatch centre, schedules, analysts, controller training
precincts.intro: 5,435 × 8,202 ft (1.66 × 2.50 km). Dispatchers give every craft its crew, slot and route; analysts study the traffic.

buildings.name: Dispatch Centre
buildings.notes: dispatchers assign craft, crews and slots
buildings.purpose: The dispatch centre, where dispatchers assign craft, crews and time slots for every flight.

buildings.name: Shuttle Schedules Office
buildings.purpose: The office that draws up and publishes the timetables for every shuttle service.

buildings.name: Cruiser Liaison Office
buildings.notes: links Flight Control with the escort cruisers

buildings.name: Analysts' Hall
buildings.purpose: A hall of analysts who study traffic data and incidents to make flying on the deck safer and smoother.

buildings.name: Controllers' Training Centre
buildings.purpose: The training centre for new traffic controllers, with simulators that recreate the control rooms.

buildings.name: Flight Radio Hub

buildings.purpose: The hub for the ship-wide flight radio and data links between controllers and craft.
